commercialPurpose: Open a premium automotive template with product spectacle, specs, and restrained luxury confidence.
purposeLayer: Hero makes the vehicle itself the primary value signal while specs and CTAs support purchase intent.
anatomyLayer: Minimal nav, oversized car side-profile media, large short headline, subtle copy, CTA, and horizontal spec strip beneath the vehicle.
hierarchyLayer: Car image dominates first, headline second, specs third, CTA fourth.
gridRhythmLayer: Light editorial hero with full-width product side profile over a horizontal metric/spec rail.
densityLimitLayer: Use section density limit: {"primaryMessage": 1, "cta": "1-2", "proofCue": "0-1 controlled cue", "mediaSystem": 1}.
originalityLayer: Extract section grammar only; do not copy exact artwork, imagery, spacing, copy, color identity, brand marks, or section order.
usageRuleLayer: Use for luxury products, vehicles, hardware, watches, or hero SKUs where object silhouette is the persuasion device.
layoutGesture: luxury product side-profile hero with spec strip
sectionSilhouette: wide light canvas topped by giant vehicle profile and anchored by compact stats rail
compositionTension: product object mass creates drama while typography stays restrained
focalPath: vehicle silhouette to headline to spec strip to CTA
negativeSpaceShape: large pale whitespace above and around the vehicle emphasizes speed and exclusivity
depthLayering: flat light base, high-resolution product layer, subtle metric capsules
moduleScaleVariation: oversized product media with tiny nav, specs, and CTA controls
breakoutBehavior: vehicle spans beyond ordinary text column and becomes the section grid anchor
antiCopyBoundary: Do not copy the exact orange car, Apex/Sports branding, specs, or image angle.
